---
title: "main"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Vamos a chambear 🤠🔥
data = read.csv("../data/ckd_clean.csv")  # No cambiar esta ruta para leer el csv, funciona para todos
head(data)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(bnlearn)
```

```{r}
data1 <- data[, c("age", "bp", "bu", "sc", "sod", "pot")]
dag1 = model2network("[age][sod][pot][bp|age][bu|age][sc|bu:bp:sod:pot]")
```

```{r}
data2 <- data[, c("age", "bgr", "bp", "rc", "sc", "hemo", "pcv")]
dag2 = model2network("[age][bgr|age][bp|age][rc|age][sc|bgr:bp:rc][hemo|sc][pcv|hemo]")
```

```{r}
data3 <- data[, c("age", "sod", "bp", "pcv", "rc", "wc", "pot", "sc")]
dag3 = model2network("[age][sod][pot][bp|age:sod][pcv|age][sc|pot:bp][rc|pcv][wc|pcv]")
```

```{r}
dag1_gbn = bn.fit(dag1, data = data1)
graphviz.plot(dag1, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
score(dag1, data = data1, type = "bic-g")
score(dag1, data = data1, type = "aic-g")
```

```{r}
dag2_gbn = bn.fit(dag2, data = data2)
graphviz.plot(dag2, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
score(dag2, data = data2, type = "bic-g")
score(dag2, data = data2, type = "aic-g")
```

```{r}
dag3_gbn = bn.fit(dag3, data = data3)
graphviz.plot(dag3, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
score(dag3, data = data3, type = "bic-g")
score(dag3, data = data3, type = "aic-g")
```
